name: Battle Live: Christmas Live
source:
The holidays are a joyful time; giving and receiving gifts, spending time with family. To celebrate the season, Pride Park is holding their annual Christmas Live, where two voted units perform together in harmony.

However, it doesn't look like half of this year's ensemble wants anything to do with the live... Or more specifically, his older sister.

[From [url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/christmas-live] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
节日总是欢乐的时光：赠送和收取礼物，与家人共度时光。为了庆祝这个季节，骄傲公园举办一年一度的圣诞Live，由投票选出的两个组合共同和谐演出。

然而，今年的演出阵容中有一半人似乎不想和Live扯上关系……更准确地说，他不想和自己的姐姐扯上关系。

（来源：[url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/christmas-live]itch.io[/url]）
